in_sanskrit.name: प्रमिला
in_sanskrit.meaning: प्राग्ज्योतिष् (प्रा) मिलिता (मिल) अस्मिन् स्थाने अस्ति (ला) । प्राग्ज्योतिष् ज्योतिर्वहनी (प्रा) अपि तत् स्थानम् अपगमनतो द्रक्ष्यति (मिल) । प्राग्ज्योतिष् वहनी अपि तत् स्थानम् प्राप्य (ला) । अतो प्रमिला । प्राग्ज्योतिष् ज्योतिर्वहनी प्राप्य ।
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who has reached before the light (knowledge, truth) or the one who has obtained the light (knowledge, truth) earlier. Pragjyotis (light-giver) will also see that place (or come to that place) and will also reach that place.

in_hindi.name: प्रमिला
in_hindi.long_meaning: She who reached earlier or came first.

in_telugu.name: ప్రమిళా
in_telugu.long_meaning: She who came before everyone else or she who was present before everyone else.

in_marathi.name: Pramila
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lotus in the pond
in_marathi.long_meaning: Pramila हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The one who has a lotus in the pond of her heart

in_bengali.name: Pramila
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lotus in the pond
in_bengali.long_meaning: Pramila একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। The one who has a lotus in the pond of her heart
